title: Reset a forgotten password
sample_questions: How do I reset my password?
I forgot my password and cannot sign in
The password reset email never arrived
I do not remember my password
How can I set a new password
Forgot the password for my TaskNest login
The password reset mail is missing
My reset link is not working
I want to reset the password of my account
Can't recall my sign-in password, what now
Where is the forgot password option
Can't remember my login password, how do I recover it
The email with the new password link has not come through
The link to choose a new password is broken
I need a fresh password for my account
response: You can reset your password from the sign-in page: choose 'Forgot password', enter your work email and open the link we send (valid for 30 minutes). If no email arrives within 5 minutes, check spam and confirm the address on your account.

title: Account locked after failed sign-in attempts
sample_questions: My account is locked after too many failed attempts
How long does an account lockout last?
I am locked out of TaskNest
My account is locked
I am locked out after entering the wrong password
How do I unlock my account

Locked out for fifteen minutes, can I speed that up
Login blocked because of failed attempts

When does the sign-in block end
How soon can I try logging in again after being locked
response: After five failed sign-in attempts an account is locked for 15 minutes. Wait for the lock to expire or reset your password from the sign-in page to unlock it immediately.

sample_questions: I lost my phone and cannot get the verification code

response: Use one of your saved backup codes to sign in, then re-register the authenticator under Security settings. If you have no backup codes, the support team must verify your identity before two-factor can be reset.

response: Invoices are under Settings > Billing > Billing history. Select any month to download a PDF invoice or receipt. Only workspace owners and billing contacts can see this page.

title: Update the payment method
sample_questions: How do I change the credit card on my account?
Our card expired, how can we update it?
Can I pay with a different payment method?
How do I replace the credit card on file
Our card has expired, where do I add a new one
Change payment method please
Update the card used for billing
Which payment options can I use
I want to use a different card
Swap the payment card on our account
The card on file is outdated
Add a new credit card for future payments
response: Go to Settings > Billing > Payment method and choose 'Replace card'. The new card is used from the next billing date. Failed payments are retried automatically three times over seven days.

title: Change or cancel a subscription
sample_questions: How do I cancel my subscription?
I want to upgrade to the Business plan
Can we move down to a cheaper plan?
How can I cancel the subscription
We want to upgrade our plan
I would like to switch to a smaller plan
Stop our subscription at the end of the month
How do I change plans
Can I downgrade next billing cycle
End my plan
How to switch from Pro to Business
Move to a lower tier next cycle

response: Workspace owners can change or cancel a plan under Settings > Billing > Plan. Upgrades apply immediately and are prorated; downgrades and cancellations take effect at the end of the current billing period.

title: Export fails or times out
sample_questions: My report export fails with an error
The CSV export keeps timing out
PDF export produces an empty file
Exporting a report gives an internal server error
The export button fails with an error message
CSV export never finishes and times out
PDF export creates a blank page
Exports are failing for the big project
Server error whenever I export the board
Report download throws a server error
Export to csv hangs forever
Exported pdf has no content
response: Exports of more than 50,000 rows can time out. Narrow the date range or filter by project and export again. Record the project name, time of the attempt and any error text; if the export still fails, a support engineer will investigate.

title: Slow loading or poor performance
sample_questions: TaskNest is very slow today
Boards take forever to load
The app lags when I open a large project
The app is very slow
Pages are loading slowly since yesterday
Everything lags when I open big boards
Performance has gotten much worse for me
Loading screen spins for minutes
TaskNest feels sluggish on my laptop
Very laggy this afternoon
A huge project takes ages to open
Scrolling is choppy on big lists
response: Clear the browser cache, disable extensions and try a supported browser. Very large boards load faster with the 'Compact view' option. If slowness is limited to one workspace, send the workspace name and a time so that engineers can check it.

title: Calendar and Slack integration problems
sample_questions: Google Calendar events are not syncing
The Slack integration stopped posting updates
My calendar sync shows the wrong dates
Calendar sync stopped working
Slack notifications are no longer posted
The integration with Google Calendar lost connection
Synced events show the wrong day
Integration keeps disconnecting every few days
Our Slack channel gets no updates from TaskNest
Slack messages from TaskNest stopped arriving
The calendar integration shows events a day late
Two-way sync with Outlook calendar broke
response: Disconnect and reconnect the integration under Settings > Integrations, then wait up to ten minutes for the first sync. Make sure the connecting user still has access to the calendar or Slack channel.

response: Basic includes 5 projects and 3 members. Pro adds unlimited projects, timelines and 20 members. Business adds single sign-on, audit exports, priority support and unlimited members. See the plans page for current limits.

response: TaskNest supports the current and previous versions of Chrome, Edge, Firefox and Safari. Mobile apps are available for iOS 16+ and Android 11+ from the official app stores.

response: Use Settings > Import. Trello and Asana boards import directly with their export files, and any spreadsheet can be imported as CSV using the downloadable template. Imports of up to 10,000 tasks are supported.

sample_questions: How do I invite a colleague?

response: Owners and admins can invite people under Settings > Members. Roles are Owner, Admin, Member and Guest; guests see only the projects they are added to.
